solver_message:
Updated `scenes/main.tscn` with `Level/CoinHighlights` and six circular `Polygon2D` children named `CoinHighlight1` through `CoinHighlight6`.

Each highlight uses 35% opacity and a tight 13.5-pixel radius. Rendered in Godot 4.4.1 and visually verified alignment over all six yellow star coins.
